behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: A rejected partial-refill request followed by admission at the exact refill time.
Gate does not call its handler on rejection.
docDelivery: Continuous refill, capacity cap and retryAfterMs:null for impossible cost.
Rejected requests do not spend tokens or invoke handlers; backwards clock rejection.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Positive integer capacity, positive finite per-second refill rate, monotonic finite nonnegative millisecond clock, positive integer costs; exact arithmetic examples use representable values. Backwards clock throws RangeError without spending tokens.
independence: Integrate injected monotonic clock, token refill and retry-after computation into request admission.
